title: doellingeria humilis
intro: Doellingeria humilis, commonly known as woodland ironweed or dwarf ironweed, is a perennial herb in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Doellingeria humilis include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
